answer: A Verified email inbox bound by one-time code delivery with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone atlas cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. The island keeps the process honest and the ridge keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
